Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap: we covered your ingestion patterns, main latency pain points, and the two production scenarios (real-time chat + nightly batch embeddings). Both look like a good fit for Redwood, and Ben and I think a short 30‑minute product intro + ops checklist will get your infra and security leads comfortable.

To keep momentum, can you pick one of the following 30‑minute windows? All times are EDT (your local time) — I included a short note on who should attend for each band.

Option A — Tue Oct 26, 09:00–09:30 EDT (early ops + product) — suggested attendees: Jordan (owner), Priya (PM), Hannah (sales lead)
Option B — Tue Oct 26, 11:00–11:30 EDT (technical + SSO) — suggested attendees: Jordan, your infra/CTO, Ben (AE), Karthik (tech lead)
Option C — Wed Oct 27, 15:00–15:30 EDT (exec + timeline) — suggested attendees: Jordan, Head of Data, Ben, Hannah

If none of these work, reply with two windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’m attaching a one‑page post‑discovery recap and a mutual action plan template so you can see what we’ll cover in the 30 minutes.

Quick asks if you confirm Option B: please include the infra/CTO or whoever owns SSO — Karthik will need their name and title so he can focus the walkthrough. Also let us know if you prefer Zoom or Webex.

Links: calendar poll (https://cal.poll/redeem/7f2b1c) — you can also pick a time there.

Thanks —
